paras: Phyllopezus heuteri is a species of gecko, a lizard in the family Phyllodactylidae. The species is endemic to Paraguay.
P. heuteri is found in Cordillera Department, Paraguay.
The specific name, heuteri, is in honor of German biologist Horst Heuter.
Maximum recorded snout-to-vent length (SVL) for P. heuteri is 8.8 cm (3.5 in).
